method: Built-in image_gen; new backgrounds, approved mockup as style reference, not UI screenshot assets.
assetFormat: WebP quality 82, 1536x1024, original generated images retained.

assets.name: courses
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: website feature-card decorative background, production bitmap.
Input image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: the approved three-card OneShowLearn mockup. Create ONE standalone background illustration matching one upper panel, NOT a screenshot and NOT the full three-card section.
Landscape 3:2 composition, intended 1536 by 1024 pixels. Premium soft-focus 3D editorial still life, matte white and lightly frosted translucent materials, soft daylight, shallow depth of field. Match the reference's delicate airy palette, physical depth, modest shadows and rounded-object style. No dark areas or sharp technical UI.
Composition must support existing HTML text: left 65% is calm bright near-white tinted negative space without prominent objects; recognizable thematic objects concentrated in the rightmost 35%, centered mainly between 30% and 75% height, safe for a wide card cropping. Gentle foreground/background defocus: motifs remain recognizable but subordinate, never smeared into featureless blobs. Faint natural shadows provide depth. The existing code will overlay text and an icon separately: render absolutely NO text, letters, numerals, icon tile, badges, interface labels, buttons, card frame, border, logo or watermark. This is only a background scenery asset, fill the entire canvas edge to edge.
Avoid: people, faces, real/fake screenshots, data/charts/statistics, invented UI, text-like scribbles, neon, high contrast, heavy glow, complex clutter, added central focal point.
Lavender palette matching the LEFT reference header. Subject: one open matte-white book at the lower-right of the object cluster and two softly leaning course document sheets behind it with only minimal abstract recessed line grooves (no readable marks). Pale lilac edges and shadows, an unobtrusive out-of-focus hint of leaves in the far-right rear corner. Calm light lavender workspace floor and atmosphere.
